name: College Tennis Exposure Camp
description_short: A two-day tennis camp for junior players, led by head college coaches and held at college and national tennis facilities. It is aimed at players who want to play college tennis.

sources.note: Drafted by the listing tool from this page

The MIT, Lehigh and Brown locations are listed without dates. They may be past summer 2026 sessions.
